show.title: Comeback of XXL CEO
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/wm4V2a
show.description: Sameer Lambani, an overweight CEO of an 800-crore company, lies in a hospital ICU reflecting on his life. Through narration, he reveals how people underestimated him despite his wealth and power. The story blends his vulnerable health condition with flashbacks of his corporate journey. It explores themes of perception, ambition, and the cost of success. Watch now.
